description: A deliberately bad draft: generic opener, banned phrases, vague CTA, no evidence references. Used as a fail fixture for the eval harness. Reflects the merged qa shape.

draft.subject: Quick question about Riverbend
draft.body: Dr. Vasquez -- I hope this finds you well. I wanted to reach out and circle back on cardiac care at Riverbend. We've helped leading institutions leverage synergies to move the needle on outcomes. Would you be open to a quick chat next week?
draft.cta: Open to a quick chat next week?

suggestions.fix: Open with the 9% cardiac case-volume decline (E1) and the throughput-ceiling quote (E3) instead of a generic greeting.
Replace 'a quick chat' with a scoped ask like '20 minutes on Mercy's turnover data against your May schedule.'
Remove banned phrase(s): circle back, synergies, quick question, quick chat, hope this finds you well, leverage, reach out, move the needle.
Opener matches template "hope this finds you". Replace with an evidence-grounded first sentence.
Populate references[] with at least one PIC evidence_id supporting the body.
